newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3939/3.3966 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3939/3.3966 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3900 to 3.3965 bid and 3.3950 to 3.3975 offered on Wednesday in a short interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3939 pounds bid and 3.3966 offered. The averages compared with 3.3966 pounds bid and 3.3976 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.391368 buy and 3.397696 sell.
